params.body:
The staging on Forge, naviskore.on-forge.com, is gone: the name no longer resolves and nothing answers. `elixir.json` already dropped it on 25 October (6f31da8b), but the README and `docs/deploy.md` still described it as a live environment that deploys from `main` on every push.

This removes it from both:

- README: the environments table lists production only, and says the Forge staging is gone.
- `docs/deploy.md`: the opening now names one staging, the rehearsal one on Ploi (`staging.naviskore.abovebeyond.ai`). The note that Elixir measures the Forge staging is replaced by what `elixir.json` says today. The refresh procedure for the Forge staging is replaced by a short note.

`bin/staging-copy.php` and `bin/staging-login.php` are left alone. Their `load`, `after` and login modes refuse any host outside `on-forge.com`, so today they run nowhere. Pointing them at the Ploi staging is a decision of its own, and the old procedure stays in this file's history.

Docs only, no code changes.
params.title: Drop the Forge staging from the docs
